android.desc:
SignalWatch is a fast, free crypto price tracker and market analysis app for Bitcoin, Ethereum, and thousands of altcoins. Get live cryptocurrency prices, 24h price changes, technical indicators, price alerts, and market news — all in one clean, low-strain dark interface.

WHY SIGNALWATCH?

📈 Live Crypto Prices
Track real-time Bitcoin and altcoin prices with a high-density dashboard. Monitor price trends, 24h changes, and overall market sentiment at a glance.

📊 Technical Indicators
Understand current market conditions with RSI, MACD, volume spikes, and multiple timeframes (15m / 1h / 4h) — the same indicators analysts use to evaluate momentum and market trends.

🔔 Price Alerts & Notifications
Set custom alerts based on price levels or technical conditions and receive instant push notifications when your conditions are met.

📰 Crypto News
Read curated headlines and summaries from the crypto market so you never miss major moves.

⭐ Watchlist & Asset Monitoring
Save your favorite coins and track them in one place. Organize your watchlist and monitor assets efficiently.

🌙 Dark Mode, Built for Long Monitoring
A glassmorphic, low-strain dark interface designed for extended market watching — fast data, minimal clutter.

FREE & AVAILABLE NOW:
All core features are currently free for everyone.

Risk Disclaimer:
SignalWatch is an informational and educational tool only. It does not provide financial, investment, or trading advice. Market data may be delayed, incomplete, or inaccurate. Past performance does not guarantee future results. All financial decisions and risks are your sole responsibility.

Download SignalWatch and track crypto prices, indicators, and news with confidence.
